title: Review --- A Tense You Build
label: ch:review-perfect
canDo: I can name the two pieces of the perfect and say which carries the person.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C49-repaso-perfecto: name the two pieces and say why this tense cost less than the present or preterite.
payoff.note: Names the shape: a tense that is BUILT costs a fixed amount, not a per-verb amount -- and Spanish reuses these same two pieces for more tenses later.
